UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User profile, cycle preferences, daily reminder config, and pinned quick-log paths.

profile.description: Active biological profile for cycle tracking visibility

cycleAnchor.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of last period start, or empty string if unset

cycleLength.description: Typical cycle length in days (15 to 60)

reminderEnabled.description: Whether daily symptom check-in reminders are enabled

reminderTime.description: 24-hour HH:MM time string for daily reminder

customFavorites.description: Up to 10 pinned symptom paths for 1-tap quick logging

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last settings update

SymptomLog.title: SymptomLog
SymptomLog.description: Individual symptom, baseline, or period-start log entry.

id.description: Unique log identifier matching document ID

dateISO.description: ISO 8601 datetime string when the symptom occurred

region.description: Body region or cycle group (e.g. Head & Neck, Flow Level)

subregion.description: Specific area or sub-category (e.g. Forehead & Temples)

side.description: Laterality if applicable (Left, Right, Both sides, None)

symptom.description: Specific symptom descriptor (e.g. Throbbing, Sharp pain)

baseline.description: True if this entry marks a symptom-free baseline day

periodStart.description: True if this entry marks the start of a menstrual period

tags.description: Up to 12 contextual trigger tags (Sleep, Stress, Food, etc.)

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when record was first synced

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when record was last modified

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user settings and cycle configuration document

/users/{userId}/logs/{logId}.description: Per-user symptom, baseline, and cycle log entries
